policies.galvangar: Sum all committed ArmorGainRecord.amount for the original Battlecry player across this game, threshold15; current remaining armor and scenario initial armor do not replace history. Ordinary captured +3/+3 and Charge for the same active physical residence.
policies.brukan: Native spell_damage3 with Nature-only selector, existing live ability lifecycle, damage and accepted split-budget rules.
policies.reno: Existing current no_duplicates DeckCondition using reviewed deck identities, followed by ordinary EFFECT Heal for captured current hero maximum health; existing healing conversion/limits apply.
policies.deck_costs: Capture actual source local_cost at native Battlecry dispatch; CheckDeckCondition evaluates every current physical deck definition and strictly compares all MINION local costs. Actual payment/global hand quote does not replace this existing explicit local policy.
policies.drekthar: On match one ordinary attributed physical random SummonFromZone from own deck, no child payment or Battlecry. No executable coverage filter or new generation pool.
policies.vanndar: On match capture all current physical deck MINION references, then ordinary ModifyStoredCost delta-3 each. Later arrivals excluded, moved original references skipped; repeat triggers re-evaluate the new deck.

uncertainties: Source local-cost capture and deck evaluation windows, global versus local cost layers and empty-minion universal conditions retain the existing explicit local comparison policy, pending exact CN calibration.
Armor aggregation, captured stat/keyword grants, school bonus and full-heal conversion timing reuse existing policies; no official execution trace claim.
Complete past source remains unbound; fixed candidate identities and all other pending source domains remain preserved.
